about: Gwyn backlog item 2: implementation map for the components lynx_tool_coverage.py reports as status-only (no separate read or action agent tool). Priority 1 is the most useful next agent tool that is safe to build. Source paths are relative to /noobia; line numbers are as of commit 8aff46d. This map proposes work; it implements nothing and grants no hardware authority. 2026-11-21: platform/display left the status-only set once lynx_media_play/stop/status (kind=image) were mapped to it as secondary components; priorities renumbered.

kinds.missing_wrapper: a safe read or action route already exists on Lynx; only the agent tool is missing
kinds.trial_needed: a route exists only as a trial or preflight tool; a reviewed live trial must come before an agent tool
kinds.blocked: no approved route; owner analysis says stop
kinds.status_is_function: the status read is the function; no further tool is needed

components.owner: Gwyn (tool), after Aria agrees on how events are consumed

existing_routes.route: NRP 380 TOUCH_STATUS: panel open, finger down, queued and dropped counts
NRP 381 TOUCH_POLL: pops one queued touch event

components.missing_tool: lynx_touch_events: read-only queue state through TOUCH_STATUS, plus an explicit, bounded 'drain N events' read through TOUCH_POLL
components.companions_needed: none for reads; TOUCH_POLL consumes events, so the tool must say so and cap the count
components.physical_proof_absent: no receipt of a person's touch arriving through an agent call (V50-TOUCH-UI-AND-AUDIO.md records the panel and UI, not an agent read)

existing_routes.route: lynx-peripheral-status headset reads jack switch bits through a read-only ioctl

components.missing_tool: none until detection is proven; the status already reads the switches
components.physical_proof_absent: physical insertion and removal of a USB Type-C audio accessory while reading the switch bits; Nord 3 has no 3.5 mm socket per published spec (not yet confirmed by looking)

existing_routes.route: Bluetooth NRP GATT daemon and trials
catalog-ready read-only proposal lynx_bluetooth_link_state (not in local_calls, not installed; accepted as proposal in Gwyn round 3)

components.missing_tool: install of the proposed read-only lynx_bluetooth_link_state (Aria's decision), then start/stop actions once autostart is proven
components.companions_needed: any radio start needs a verified stop (radio off) and a status read
components.physical_proof_absent: autostart and long-uptime reboot behaviour; a 15-minute same-boot hold passed

components.missing_tool: lynx_camera_capture, only after a guarded cold-boot ISP package and a local disable switch
components.companions_needed: capture must be bounded and need no stop; any preview mode needs a stop
components.physical_proof_absent: main IMX890 and front S5K3P9SP untested; macro and wide produced frames only with a RAM-patched ISP; drivers are not loaded after a reboot

components.missing_tool: a position read, after a clear-sky fix is proven
components.companions_needed: starting the receiver needs a stop and a status read
components.physical_proof_absent: a position fix; 108 checksum-valid NMEA sentences had fix quality 0

existing_routes.route: guarded RAM NFC probe (chip GET_VERSION only)
source DT: NXP SN110 at nq@28, compatible nxp,sn-nci (Lynx's own Nord 3 tree)

components.missing_tool: a tag-read tool, after a bounded tag exchange is proven
components.companions_needed: turning the RF field on needs a stop and a status read

existing_routes.route: mtu3 controller preflight and RAM-only ACM gadget trial
cold-boot gadget design and OpenRC template (not installed; timeout syntax fix B9 pending)

components.missing_tool: a gadget-state read, then agent-facing serial use, after persistence is proven
components.companions_needed: configuring a gadget needs a teardown and a status read
components.physical_proof_absent: cold-boot persistence, disconnect and reconnect; the ACM link was attended and RAM-only

existing_routes.route: offline spi7.0 oplus,fp_spi trace; no driver bound

components.missing_tool: none until a sensor identity, driver and secure userspace route exist
components.physical_proof_absent: sensor identity, a bound driver, and any function

components.owner: Banshee (analysis) and Aria (live); no live work authorized

components.physical_proof_absent: modem start, registration, and RF isolation
